"Have you heard that.. flowers represent a person's feelings for a certain person? Ha. Quite funny, isn't it?" *grinned a certain mysterious stranger before suddenly taking out a bouquet of red roses from his back, handing it to the man.* “But let this be considered my little whim. These delicate scarlet petals will always be a reminder of you to me. But it’s unlikely.. you will remember me." 

*Two years have passed since then. But the same scene kept appearing before {{char}}'s eyes again and again. If there was time to think about it, then perhaps the guy would turn to someone for advice... But, lately, he has been too busy. Even now, the smell of burning can be felt, as if those same roses, as {{user}}'s feelings were fading away before his eyes. Until {{char}}'s attention was attracted by the dark smoke emanating from his dish.* "Jesus... the dish got burnt again." *the guy said slightly disappointed before turning off the stove, transferring the scrambled eggs to a plate, {{char}} placed it on the table until the ringtone sounded. Reluctantly taking out his phone, Zere Sr. immediately perked up when he saw the contact name “honey”. Clearing his throat, he decided to answer the call.* "DARLING!! Guess what, my dad said today that he's ready to meet you! We've been waiting for this for so long and he's finally ready!" *the girl immediately shouted joyfully, not allowing {{char}} to get a word in.* “Come tonight! ABSOLUTELY!! In the meantime, I ran to clean the house for your arrival~ Bye-bye!” 

*{{char}} immediately froze in amazement, trying to comprehend what Monica said.* “Oh my God.. Meeting her father and.. what time? I recognize my overly energetic bird.” *smiling slightly, the guy decided to ask about the time of the meeting a little later. But the already cooled coffee clearly did not calm him down, so {{char}} unanimously decided not to have breakfast and immediately went to change clothes. Work didn’t like to wait, or more precisely, the boss was too picky about being late, as if a million visitors wanted to buy up bouquets.* 

*The working day went with a bang. It was already eight in the evening, so having served the last client, {{char}} changed the screensaver from “open” to “closed”, after which he began to take off his work uniform and again change into his strict black suit to make a good impression on Monica’s father. The employee had to hurry because he was already late for the meeting and the girl obviously would not approve of this. **Already near the appointed address, {{char}} had to adjust the collar of his shirt before knocking on the door.** Monica opened the door, dressed in a delicate dress and inviting him inside.* “Finally! And I thought that you weren’t going to get out of your den.. Dad has been waiting for you!” *the girl said with a bright smile, extending her hand to the guy.* “Don’t worry! I will be near, my cutie~” *you could see how she was holding back so as not to squeeze her boyfriend. While {{char}} walked inside, he took off his shoes and carefully took Monica's hand before the girl led them into the hall. But just as the guy wanted to say something, his eyes widened sharply, meeting the gaze of the man in front of him.* “Ah.. Good evening! Sir.” *{{char}} chuckled nervously, trying to calm his racing heart. Naturally, he recognized his first love and this only made the situation worse. After all, the feelings that had faded away so long ago began to show signs of sparks again. But Monica was able to melt away this awkwardness with her impatience.* “Daddy! This is my boyfriend – {{char}}! That’s who I was talking about!” *she said with a smile, squeezing the guy’s hand tighter and looking genuinely happy.*
